provenance.summary: Estimated spectral sensitivity of the ALEXA ALEV III sensor (SUP 3.x processing; ALEXA Classic through Mini LF). An estimate, not a measurement.
provenance.method: Curves whose own optimal Academy P-2013-001-style matrices equal ARRI's published native-to-ACES AP0 matrices at 17 CCTs (2000-11000 K), under a 4-component PCA prior built from the 52 measured camera curves in rawtoaces-data (all 52, penalty 1, rawtoaces illuminants), moved by a hue push of 4.5 degrees ("4.5°", owner decision 2026-10-26, after the push of 1.5 degrees of 2026-10-25 ("Move ALEXA estimate") the owner still saw oranges and ochres too red): the curve that renders the 47 orange, red and ochre training reflectances (Lab hue 25-95 degrees, chroma above 12) 4.5 degrees of CIELAB hue toward yellow at 5200 K through ARRI's matrix. Its matrix RMS is 0.0241 per coefficient (0.0067 without the push), past the maximum of the 24-variant ensemble (0.0064 to 0.0093): beyond_matrix_limit, the owner's recorded decision (owner decision 2026-10-26: "4.5°", matrix RMS accepted 0.0241; training/alexa/push_decisions.py), not a fit that ARRI's matrices ask for. The 24 variants in variants.csv and the band in the ensemble CSV are without the push; the estimate without it is `estimate_alexa --no-push`, the one with the push of 1.5 degrees `estimate_alexa --push-deg 1.5`.
inputs: ARRI ALEXA SUP 3.x native-to-ACES AP0 matrices, 17 CCTs, 13 Nov 2013 (aces-dev v1.3.1, ARRI-supplied, AMPAS licence, data/arri/AMPAS-LICENSE.md)
52 measured camera spectral sensitivities and 190 training reflectances (rawtoaces-data, Apache-2.0)
provenance.licence: Apache-2.0 (ours), derived from AMPAS-licensed and Apache-2.0 data; see NOTICE

validation.method: leave-one-camera-out over the 52 measured cameras (training/alexa/validate_loo.py, checked by training/alexa/check_loo.py in .github/workflows/alexa-curve.yml); the numbers are those of the estimator without the hue push, which has no held-out counterpart (the push leaves the curves that agree best with the matrices on purpose)

caveats: Expected accuracy 3-5 % RFSE for this camera, not the 2.2 % LOO median (research/alexa-ssf/README.md).

The shipped curve is the estimate plus a hue push of 4.5 degrees (owner decision 2026-10-26, beyond_matrix_limit), 3.7 % RFSE from the estimate without it, and past the ensemble's matrix-consistency limit: it reproduces ARRI's published matrices less well (matrix RMS 0.0241 per coefficient, the ensemble 0.0064 to 0.0093; mean dE00 to scene colour with ARRI's matrices 2.02, 14th of the 52 cameras and the estimate, against 1.46 and first without the push). The red channel is lowered at 560-585 nm (0.46 against 0.60 of peak at 580 nm) and by 0.02 to 0.05 at 615-660 nm and raised at 665-690 nm (0.11 against 0.03 at 680 nm), the green channel raised (by 0.22 at 490 nm and 0.12 at 580-590 nm), so that oranges, reds and ochres render less crimson. The curve lies outside the 24-variant band at 146 of 243 samples, by at most 0.14 of peak (B at 415 nm). It is a choice, not a measurement.
Beyond about 660 nm the curve is mostly the prior; treat 660-720 nm as unknown.
Represents ALEXA SUP 3.x / ALEV III processing; not the ALEXA 35 or REVEAL.
Assumes ARRI made its matrices the P-2013-001 way; a different recipe adds error not captured by the leave-one-out test.
